recipe_rules.record: Sequential RFC-6901 pointer edits to deep copy; add creates object member, replace/remove require existing target; canonical serialize and HMAC AFTER edits.
recipe_rules.envelope: Sequential pointer edits to literal signed base envelope; canonical serialize envelope, never resign.
recipe_rules.raw: Canonical base envelope bytes then raw_transform; append ASCII spaces (byte 0x20) to exact total_bytes; replace_utf8 replaces entire response.
recipe_rules.record_raw: Canonical base record bytes; prefix_duplicate_key inserts literal JSON member after opening brace followed by comma; sign those exact bytes without reparsing.
recipe_rules.context: Named trusted test prerequisites, not wire fields. Integrity and transport labels are scenario facts, not real commissioning evidence. Restart reloads same state/pin; missing/corrupt never initializes.
recipe_rules.scope: Record refusal invalidates source feed; named component refusal leaves others independently accepted; ACCEPT preserves historical/unavailable states.
recipe_rules.acceptance: Predetermined not measured. Literal base envelopes carry fixture-key signatures, never host credentials or live receipts.
recipe_rules.verification_limit: Authoring checks may parse JSON, decode literal base envelopes and check fixture HMACs/recipes; no proposed dashboard reader, host controls, classifier or collector has been executed.
